title: Add SQLite SQL migration runner and ledger
description:
Implement the migration runner and schema_migrations ledger for migration-first SQLite schema management.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a schema_migrations table with version, name, checksum, and applied_at.
- Discover migration files in deterministic version order.
- Validate contiguous version numbers and unique names.
- Apply pending migrations transactionally.
- Refuse to start if an already-applied migration's checksum no longer matches.
- Refuse ambiguous, duplicate, missing, or out-of-order migrations with clear errors.
- Keep the runner small and deterministic; do not introduce an ORM/migration framework unless separately justified.
close_reason: Migration runner + schema_migrations ledger landed in PR #316 (merged). Discovery/validation, checksum drift detection, per-migration transactional apply.
